name: URL Slug Generator
title: URL Slug Generator: Turn Titles into Clean URLs
description: Convert titles into clean, lowercase URL slugs. Strips accents and punctuation, optional stop word removal and length limit, bulk mode. Runs in your browser.
card: Turn titles into short, clean, lowercase URL slugs.
lede: Paste one title or many, one per line, and get clean hyphenated slugs with accents and punctuation removed.
answer_q: How do I make a good URL slug?
answer: Use a few lowercase words that describe the page, separated by hyphens, with no accents, punctuation or dates that will go stale. This tool converts any title into that format.
steps: Paste a title, or several on separate lines.
Keep the hyphen separator, which search engines read as a space.
Set a max length if your CMS has a limit.
Turn on stop word removal for shorter slugs.

examples.title: Accents, symbols and punctuation
examples.input: Café & Crème Brûlée: A Beginner's Guide

faq.a: Hyphens. Google's URL guidance recommends hyphens to separate words, because underscores can join words together.
It is optional. Removing words like the and of shortens slugs, but keep them if the slug reads badly without them.

faq.q: Should I change slugs on pages that are already live?
faq.a: Only with a 301 redirect from the old URL, or you lose links and rankings that point to it.
It strips accents (é to e) and maps a few special letters like ß to ss. Scripts without a Latin form are removed, so check slugs for those pages by hand.
